UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
                              EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA
                                     Alexandria Division

MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,                           )
                                                  )
                       Plaintiff,                 )
                                                  )
       v.                                         )    Civil Action No. 1:26-cv-2331 (RDA/IDD)
                                                  )
KATIE HALL, et al.,                               )
                                                  )
                       Defendants.                )


                                             NOTICE

       This matter comes before the Court on Defendant Katie Hall’s Motion to Dismiss (Dkt.

45). In accordance with Roseboro v. Garrison, 528 F.2d 309 (4th Cir. 1975), Plaintiff is hereby

NOTIFIED that an opposing party has filed a motion to dismiss that, if granted, could result in the

dismissal of some or all of Plaintiff’s claims.

       Plaintiff is ADVISED that Plaintiff is entitled to file a response opposing the motion within

twenty-one (21) days of the filing date of this Notice. Plaintiff is FURTHER ADVISED that the

Court could dismiss some or all of Plaintiff’s claims on the basis of the moving party’s papers if

Plaintiff does not file a response.

       If Plaintiff submits a response, Defendant may file a reply within six (6) days after the

service of Plaintiff’s response. See E.D. Va. Loc. Civ. R. 7(F)(1). Thereafter, “[n]o further briefs

or written communications may be filed without first obtaining leave of Court.” Id.



Alexandria, Virginia
September 2, 2026
